target_customer: Startups, SMBs and scaling teams that send contracts
problem: Existing eSignature tools such as DocuSign are slow and clunky for sending and signing everyday contracts.
business_model: Pay-as-you-go per signed contract (free for 0 to 5, 4 dollars for 6 to 20, 3 dollars above 20), enterprise plans with API

founders.name: Michael Wang
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as the only founder; background not given. Search snippets from yespress mention other names (Garrett Wu, Merry Sui Yuan) which could not be confirmed on an opened source.

competitors.name: DocuSign
competitors.what: market-leading eSignature platform that ROGER positions against

competitors.name: HelloSign (Dropbox Sign)
competitors.what: simple web eSignature tool, acquired by Dropbox in 2019

competitors.name: PandaDoc
competitors.what: document and eSignature platform with templates

technical_complexity.rationale: eSignature flows, templates and audit trails are well understood engineering; the hard part is legal validity and polish, which are standard.

defensibility.rationale: Many eSignature products existed (DocuSign, HelloSign, PandaDoc, SignRequest) and a simpler UI is easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents did not visibly copy ROGER; no source on any response. Box bought SignRequest in 2021 and Dropbox owned HelloSign, showing large players consolidating the segment.

market_need_then: Complaints about clunky eSignature tools are the stated premise; the YC pitch compares the opportunity to Linear versus Jira. No quantified demand found.

branding.name_origin: The site uses the tagline Roger that, a radio phrase for acknowledged; no source states the origin explicitly.
branding.domain_note: Uses thanksroger.com rather than roger.com, suggesting the exact .com was unavailable; not sourced.

identity.voice_and_tone: playful: Roger that, The Best Way to Sign Contracts Since Handshakes

brand_strength.rationale: Playful memorable name and tagline, but a common first name shared with many other companies and no press about the brand found.

outcome_analysis: ROGER is a small YC Winter 2021 eSignature startup that sells pay-per-contract signing to startups and SMBs. Public evidence shows a live product into 2026 but no verified funding, no exit and no traction numbers. The segment is crowded with DocuSign and consolidating rivals, so the story so far is a low-visibility, low-capital product.
notes: Funding: aggregators conflict (Extruct pre-seed; startupintros lists a 120K seed dated 2024-09 and 9.1M total, likely a different company); nothing credible confirmed, so no rounds recorded. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. yespress pages returned 403 so were not opened. The DocuSign competitor entry is sourced to the YC page (undated, current). HelloSign and PandaDoc sources are vendor or older pages, weak. Founder education and prior employers not found. Name origin not stated by any source.
